{{Quote|The good old days on Contruum.|[[Cryle Cavv]]|<ref name="Small Favors">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>}}
A '''rebellion''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] was fought against the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and his [[Cracken's Crew/Legends|Cracken's Crew]]. They ultimately freed the world from Imperial rule before Cracken's son [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash]] enrolled in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. Cracken's Crew joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031113cracken|text=Pash Cracken}}</ref>
